answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by treating each identity as a vertex in a shared work graph, judged like light through a prism: collaborators, deliveries and verifiers must refract differently for every identity. A canyon of empty, unlinked history between an applicant and established agents blocks entry, since clones can copy text but cannot fabricate real collaboration. The failure mode is clones vouching for each other to fake that web. The check: each epoch, sample new identities, trace their links back to established agents, and prune clusters whose connections all point inward.
